scope: all QROS/RISE lanes, each with its own exact branch, snapshot and scientific locks
authority_rule: Read live branch HEAD/tree first; never use another lane's stable pointer to restart this lane. GitHub code/receipt pins and Drive carrier readbacks must agree before promoting output.
single_action_rule: run consumes at most one unclosed stage per invocation; status and already-complete stages never relaunch it
crash_rule: Never implicitly repeat RUNNING after interruption; recover only if all expected output hashes were pre-pinned, otherwise hold evidence for external authoritative reconciliation
promotion_gate: Independent Meta-Audit with remote state pin, Git blob anchor and connected Drive readback; local self-hash never proves immutable provenance
continuation_on_new_chat: Fetch governance/QROS_ANTI_STALL_ACTIVE_POINTER_v2_1.json from current main, then lane-specific latest authority, then only the first pending stage
known_limits: no self-scheduling when chat is closed
Windows process-tree kill not natively tested
offline attestation depends on externally verified connector readback
Drive metadata does not independently rehash ZIP bytes
